q: In the letter to Titus, what does Paul call Titus?
quote: To Titus, my true child in our common faith

q: In Titus, what has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone?
quote: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.

q: In Titus, Paul tells Titus to show himself an example by doing what?
quote: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works.

q: In Titus, on which island did Paul leave Titus?
why: To appoint elders in every town.
quote: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished

q: In Titus, God saved us not by our deeds but according to His what?
why: Through new birth by the Spirit.
quote: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy

q: In Titus, whom was Titus to appoint in every town of Crete?
why: To set the churches in order.
quote: and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

q: In Titus, where did Paul plan to spend the winter?
why: He asked Titus to come there.
quote: make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

q: In Titus, whom did Paul plan to send, Artemas or whom?
why: Then Titus could come to Paul.
quote: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you
